### 2026-10-17: # Finished the case!

**6h**

# Finished the case!

This project was a lot more straightforward than the pcb. That, and the fact that i know more about cad than pcb design meant i could finish this with 5 hrs less time (maybe i should have shot higher?)

i also got access to a mouse which made the entire cad process _much, much easier_

My design is split up into a base and a top, screwed together by M6 screws :

![the print cad](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/Txtz56AlpXYSvJEhT04HAEIaAgIKQaYV/4216626f50e61c2d9a0907f4aaa73eee68af82480235f91050853085e5985d93.png)

i started with the base:

![entry3pic1](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/Txtz56AlpXYSvJEhT04HAEIaAgIKQaYV/997d51e45389e7f4228a0fec858081998ffb0f51bae1bd8d2c7b617d875c9866.png)
and eventually ended up with this:

![the base](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/Txtz56AlpXYSvJEhT04HAEIaAgIKQaYV/f4ef5ec5376a99e03d0264d5cbf2110dad2e61b72d717bb346463b31e190b9d4.png)

i then started on the top:

![the top on  top of the base](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/Txtz56AlpXYSvJEhT04HAEIaAgIKQaYV/aa1dcabba60c06040be80046f04fccd30ab52269ba8fc6e7c3ded73c016d25b3.png)

_ i then added some holes to the base because i realised i needed somewhere to mount my joystick lol (not shown in the print cad because i added them in later)_

![the base, now with some holes](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/Txtz56AlpXYSvJEhT04HAEIaAgIKQaYV/0dd09c2179212c09c5bd53736067c31e744a8eb4da6530238f98385e69db800e.png)

these were actually a pain to align lmao because i was worried about how accurate my pcb design was, so i made the holes slightly bigger to compensate for variation, but then placement was also terrible because of the bigger hole size. Not to mention how it appeared to change alignment when you moved the camera 5mm or zoomed at all:

![alignment](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/Txtz56AlpXYSvJEhT04HAEIaAgIKQaYV/b63bbc030bb5d10e45261d7fda8d72a3cf620d005be0f29bd044d5c7c2d69ae0.png)
^^these look like they arent aligned but they actually are (unless im lwk js selling which we'll find out on build week)

i def should have made my pcb more precise and/or had a master document for everything, because trying to get measurements of any precision for the kicad placement was painful.

**tldr; i finished my entire project yay**
